meta.title: Sampan: stablecoins in and out of Bitcoin Cash
meta.description.none: Stablecoins in and out of Bitcoin Cash. Each flow opens once it has been measured on mainnet.
meta.description.swap: Swap BCH and PUSD on Bitcoin Cash from your own wallet.
meta.description.land: Send BCH from any wallet to a landing address and receive PUSD on Bitcoin Cash.
meta.description.cross: Bring {symbols} into Bitcoin Cash as PUSD and send PUSD out as {symbols}.
meta.description.swap-land: Swap BCH and PUSD on Bitcoin Cash, or land BCH from any wallet as PUSD.
meta.description.swap-cross: Swap BCH and PUSD on Bitcoin Cash, and move {symbols} in and out as PUSD.
meta.description.land-cross: Land BCH from any wallet as PUSD, and move {symbols} in and out of Bitcoin Cash.
meta.description.swap-land-cross: Swap BCH and PUSD, land BCH as PUSD, and move {symbols} in and out of Bitcoin Cash.
banner.note: New project. First commit after the 14 November start. Planning notes are in /preparation.
hero.title: Stablecoins in and out of Bitcoin Cash.
hero.sub.none: Each flow opens here once it has been measured on mainnet. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap: Swap BCH and PUSD through Cauldron pools, signed in your own wallet. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.land: Send BCH from any wallet or exchange to your landing address and it arrives as PUSD, or comes back to you. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.cross: Bring {symbols} in as PUSD in your BCH wallet, and send PUSD out as {symbols}. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap-land: Swap BCH and PUSD through Cauldron pools, signed in your own wallet. Or send BCH from any wallet or exchange to your landing address and it arrives as PUSD. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap-cross: Swap BCH and PUSD on Bitcoin Cash, bring {symbols} in as PUSD, and send PUSD out as {symbols}. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.land-cross: Bring in BCH from any wallet or exchange, or {symbols} from another chain, as PUSD in your BCH wallet. Send PUSD out as {symbols}. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap-land-cross: Swap BCH and PUSD, land BCH as PUSD, and move {symbols} in and out as PUSD. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.honest: On Bitcoin Cash every step is a transaction you sign, or a contract that can only pay you. The crossing between chains is carried by {route}.
scene.label: A sampan carrying a coin across the river between two banks
tabs.label: What do you want to do?
wallet.scan: Scan this with Selene, Paytaca or Cashonize. Wallet on this phone? Copy the link instead.
wallet.pasteHint: Paste it in your wallet's WizardConnect screen.
wallet.scanFailed: Could not read your wallet's coins. Disconnect and connect again.
swap.enterAmount: Enter an amount to see what you receive.
swap.poolFee: Pool fee: {pct}% of the BCH side, kept by the pool.
swap.networkFee: Network fee: at most {fee} BCH. Your wallet shows the exact fee before you sign.
swap.done: Swapped. The transaction has been sent to the network.
swap.err.short: Your wallet has less than this amount.
swap.err.check: Stopped before your wallet: the transaction did not match what this page shows. Nothing was signed.
swap.err.wallet: Your wallet did not sign. Nothing was sent.
swap.err.below_min: The BCH side must be at least {min} BCH.
swap.err.no_liquidity: The pools cannot fill this amount right now.
swap.err.not_enough_funds: Not enough in your wallet for this amount and the network fee.
swap.err.price_moved: The price moved. Check the new amount and try again.
swap.err.gave_up: The pools kept moving. Please start again.
swap.err.offline: The Sampan server could not be reached. Try again.
swap.err.rejected: The network did not accept the transaction. Nothing was sent.
swap.err.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
swap.err.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was sent.
crossing.title: Crossing status
crossing.missing: There is no crossing at this link.
crossing.step.broadcast: Signed and sent to the network
crossing.status.stale: A pool moved before sending. The swap can be built again.
crossing.status.broadcast: Sent. The transaction is in the network.
crossing.status.failed: Not sent. Nothing left your wallet.
land.ownerLabel: Your {symbol} address (token address, starts with z)
land.err.owner: That is not a Bitcoin Cash address.
land.err.mismatch: Stopped: the address from the server did not match the one this page worked out. Do not pay it.
land.err.closed: Landing addresses are not open right now.
land.promise: Any BCH that reaches this address is converted to {symbol} and paid to you. If the price moves more than {pct}% first, the BCH comes back to you.
land.validity: Valid for payments in the next {hours} hours; later payments are returned if the price has moved.
land.min: Pay at least {min} BCH. For {min} BCH you receive at least {tokens} {symbol}.
land.qrLabel: QR code: pay {amount} BCH to your landing address
land.noWallet: No wallet to connect? Scan the landing address with any BCH wallet.
land.prompt: Pay {amount} BCH to your Sampan landing address
land.paid: Paid. Taking you to the status page.
judge.title: Judging? A real mainnet transaction in about a minute.
judge.step1: Connect Selene, Paytaca or Cashonize with WizardConnect.
judge.step2: Pay {amount} BCH to your landing address. It arrives as {symbol} by itself.
crossing.land.status.open: Waiting for BCH at the landing address. This page checks every few seconds.
crossing.land.status.converted: Done. The {symbol} is at your address.
crossing.land.status.returned: Price moved. Your BCH was returned to your address.
crossing.land.swapLink: Swap it on the Swap tab
crossing.card.title: Recovery card
crossing.card.text: With this card anyone can finish the landing with the open-source finisher script, without the Sampan server. It lives in this link only and is never sent to the server.
crossing.card.missing: This link has no recovery card. Use the card saved when the address was made.
crossing.card.bad: The recovery card in this link is damaged.
footer.sampan: A sampan is the small boat that takes people across the river in Malaysia.
alerts.unhealthy: Sampan is not healthy: the public page or /healthz failed twice in a row. Check the container and the route; undo with deploy/deploy.sh --rollback if the last deploy caused it.
alerts.recovered: Sampan is healthy again: the page and /healthz answer 200. Nothing to do.
